title: Administrative boundaries · ADM0, ADM1, ADM2
description: Administrative units of the world: countries (ADM0) everywhere, and first- and second-level units (ADM1, ADM2) for the countries whose entry in the boundary registry has been verified. Every unit has a code unit_id: ISO3 for countries, ISO3-level-national code below them (for example USA-2-51059). Units carry the geometry used on the map; for the United States and Norway, the national geometry used for calculations is published in separate analysis files. Areas that the chosen point of view assigns to no country are a separate layer.

coverage.geography: World (ADM0); ADM1 and ADM2 for the countries with a verified entry in the boundary registry
known_gaps: ADM1 and ADM2 units exist only for countries whose registry entry has been verified: ADM1 for the United States, France, the United Kingdom and Norway; ADM2 for the United States, France and Norway.
The regions and departments of France and the four countries of the United Kingdom are built from Natural Earth 1:10m units. They are generalized and are not the official national boundaries.
Disputed and unassigned areas are not part of any country.

verification.method: Units are built by script from the sources by the method named in the registry; the registry marks a country and level as verified before its units are published. The validation report of the build is published next to the units.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
Unit counts of the release were counted from the files: ADM0 242, ADM1 89, ADM2 3602; unit_id is unique across all levels.
Every country and level with ADM1 or ADM2 units in the release has verified = true in the boundary registry.
Columns of every published Parquet file are declared in fields[].
